sloka: दृष्टो मया आश्रमः सौम्य बहु आश्चर्यः कृतआत्मनाम् ।विश्वस्त मृग शार्दूलो नाना विहग सेवितः ॥३-७५-३॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭo mayā āśramaḥ saumya bahu āścaryaḥ kṛtaātmanām ।viśvasta mṛga śārdūlo nānā vihaga sevitaḥ ॥3-75-3॥

translations.english: O handsome one, we have seen this highly wonderful hermitage, where deer and tigers dwell together with mutual confidence, where birds of all kinds inhabit.
